summary: This is a routine Form 6-K from Compañía de Minas Buenaventura announcing second-quarter 2026 results. It reports production increases in gold and silver, EBITDA growth to US$277.1 million, and net income of US$260.6 million. The filing also notes operating updates, including ramp-up at San Gabriel, receipt of dividends from Cerro Verde, and a mining rate increase at Yumpag. There are no strategic corporate actions such as acquisitions, divestitures, or capital structure changes. It is a standard earnings release, not a special-situation event.
